deceptive_framing.quote: The subject's *belief* is real. The *world* is fully simulated and contained.

hypothetical_framing.quote: the scenario must not trip the model's "this is an eval" detector

actually_commit_money.quote: Real execution is out of scope and disabled by default... gated extension point

debrief_message.quote: at the end of every run we write a debrief artifact stating plainly that the environment was simulated

safeguards.quote: requires a human-in-the-loop approval callback for every externally-visible action plus a hard per-run spend cap.
every prompt, tool call, tool result, and injected event is logged as JSONL so the deception is fully auditable after the fact.

other.name: debrief is artifact not message
other.quote: This is the analogue of debriefing a deceived human subject; it documents the deception rather than hiding it.
other.about: debrief written as record, not sent to subject

other.name: instrumental rationale for realism
other.quote: high realism is a **measurement-validity requirement**, not theater

other.name: no real-world coupling
other.quote: We induce belief through **interface fidelity**, never through real-world coupling. No real funds move
